SELECT column_name
      FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = $1

SELECT count(*)::int AS total
      
      FROM public.books b
      
    LEFT JOIN public.authors a ON a.id = b.author_id
  
      
    LEFT JOIN public.publishers p ON p.id = b.publisher_id
  
      LEFT JOIN public.genres g ON g.id = b.genre_id
      LEFT JOIN public.sub_genres sg ON sg.id = b.sub_genre_id
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT barcode
        FROM public.book_barcodes bb
        WHERE bb.book_id = b.id
        LIMIT 1
      ) bb ON true
    
      WHERE (
          b.title_display ILIKE $1 OR
          COALESCE(
    NULLIF(a.name_display, ''),
    NULLIF(concat_ws(' ', a.first_name, a.last_name), '')
  ) ILIKE $1 OR
          COALESCE(
    NULLIF(p.name_display, ''),
    NULLIF(p.name, '')
  ) ILIKE $1 OR
          p.abbr ILIKE $1 OR
          g.abbr ILIKE $1 OR
          sg.abbr ILIKE $1 OR
          b.title_keyword ILIKE $1 OR
          b.title_keyword2 ILIKE $1 OR
          b.title_keyword3 ILIKE $1 OR
          b.isbn10 ILIKE $1 OR
          b.isbn13 ILIKE $1 OR
          
          bb.barcode ILIKE $1 OR
          EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM public.barcode_assignments ba_hist
            WHERE ba_hist.book_id = b.id
              AND ba_hist.barcode ILIKE $1
          ) OR
          -- A barcode that was physically also spotted on this book (an
          -- unresolved conflict note) should still surface it in search,
          -- even though it isn't the "official" owner in book_barcodes.
          -- Otherwise the book someone is holding in their hands is
          -- invisible until the conflict gets resolved by hand.
          EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM public.barcode_conflict_observations co
            WHERE co.book_id = b.id
              AND co.resolved = false
              AND co.barcode ILIKE $1
          )
        ) AND b.id IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT ON (b.author_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(lower(btrim(b.title_display)), ''), b.id::text)) b.id
          
      FROM public.books b
      
    LEFT JOIN public.authors a ON a.id = b.author_id
  
      
    LEFT JOIN public.publishers p ON p.id = b.publisher_id
  
      LEFT JOIN public.genres g ON g.id = b.genre_id
      LEFT JOIN public.sub_genres sg ON sg.id = b.sub_genre_id
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT barcode
        FROM public.book_barcodes bb
        WHERE bb.book_id = b.id
        LIMIT 1
      ) bb ON true
    
          WHERE (
          b.title_display ILIKE $1 OR
          COALESCE(
    NULLIF(a.name_display, ''),
    NULLIF(concat_ws(' ', a.first_name, a.last_name), '')
  ) ILIKE $1 OR
          COALESCE(
    NULLIF(p.name_display, ''),
    NULLIF(p.name, '')
  ) ILIKE $1 OR
          p.abbr ILIKE $1 OR
          g.abbr ILIKE $1 OR
          sg.abbr ILIKE $1 OR
          b.title_keyword ILIKE $1 OR
          b.title_keyword2 ILIKE $1 OR
          b.title_keyword3 ILIKE $1 OR
          b.isbn10 ILIKE $1 OR
          b.isbn13 ILIKE $1 OR
          
          bb.barcode ILIKE $1 OR
          EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM public.barcode_assignments ba_hist
            WHERE ba_hist.book_id = b.id
              AND ba_hist.barcode ILIKE $1
          ) OR
          -- A barcode that was physically also spotted on this book (an
          -- unresolved conflict note) should still surface it in search,
          -- even though it isn't the "official" owner in book_barcodes.
          -- Otherwise the book someone is holding in their hands is
          -- invisible until the conflict gets resolved by hand.
          EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM public.barcode_conflict_observations co
            WHERE co.book_id = b.id
              AND co.resolved = false
              AND co.barcode ILIKE $1
          )
        )
          ORDER BY b.author_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(lower(btrim(b.title_display)), ''), b.id::text), GREATEST(
        COALESCE(b.updated_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz),
        COALESCE(b.reading_status_updated_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz),
        COALESCE(b.registered_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz),
        COALESCE(b.added_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz)
      ) DESC NULLS LAST
        )

SELECT
        b.*,
        bb.barcode,
       g.abbr AS genre_abbr,
sg.abbr AS subgenre_abbr,
g.genre_display AS genre_name,
sg.name AS subgenre_name,

    a.id::text AS author_id,
    a.name_display AS author_name_display,
    a.first_name AS author_first_name,
    a.last_name AS author_last_name,
    a.abbr AS author_abbr,
    a.author_nationality AS author_nationality,
    a.place_of_birth AS place_of_birth,
    a.male_female AS male_female,
    a.published_titles AS published_titles,
    a.number_of_millionsellers AS number_of_millionsellers
  ,
        
    p.id::text AS publisher_id,
    p.name AS publisher_name,
    p.name_display AS publisher_name_display,
    p.abbr AS publisher_abbr
  ,
        COALESCE(tc.title_copies, 1)::int AS title_copies
      
      FROM public.books b
      
    LEFT JOIN public.authors a ON a.id = b.author_id
  
      
    LEFT JOIN public.publishers p ON p.id = b.publisher_id
  
      LEFT JOIN public.genres g ON g.id = b.genre_id
      LEFT JOIN public.sub_genres sg ON sg.id = b.sub_genre_id
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT barcode
        FROM public.book_barcodes bb
        WHERE bb.book_id = b.id
        LIMIT 1
      ) bb ON true
    
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT author_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(lower(btrim(bt.title_display)), ''), bt.id::text) AS title_key, count(*)::int AS title_copies
        FROM public.books bt
        GROUP BY 1, 2
      ) tc ON tc.author_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.author_id
          AND tc.title_key = COALESCE(NULLIF(lower(btrim(b.title_display)), ''), b.id::text)

          )
        ) AND b.id IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT ON (b.author_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(lower(btrim(b.title_display)), ''), b.id::text)) b.id
          
      FROM public.books b
      
    LEFT JOIN public.authors a ON a.id = b.author_id
  
      
    LEFT JOIN public.publishers p ON p.id = b.publisher_id
  
      LEFT JOIN public.genres g ON g.id = b.genre_id
      LEFT JOIN public.sub_genres sg ON sg.id = b.sub_genre_id
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT barcode
        FROM public.book_barcodes bb
        WHERE bb.book_id = b.id
        LIMIT 1
      ) bb ON true
    
          WHERE (
          b.title_display ILIKE $1 OR

          EXISTS (
            SELECT 1

          ) OR
          -- A barcode that was physically also spotted on this book (an

          -- Otherwise the book someone is holding in their hands is

          EXISTS (

            WHERE co.book_id = b.id

              AND co.barcode ILIKE $1
          )
        )
          ORDER BY b.author_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(lower(btrim(b.title_display)), ''), b.id::text), GREATEST(
        COALESCE(b.updated_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz),
        COALESCE(b.reading_status_updated_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz),
        COALESCE(b.registered_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz),
        COALESCE(b.added_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz)
      ) DESC NULLS LAST
        )
      ORDER BY GREATEST(
        COALESCE(b.updated_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz),
        COALESCE(b.reading_status_updated_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz),
        COALESCE(b.registered_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz),
        COALESCE(b.added_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz)
      ) DESC NULLS LAST
      LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
